evidence.limits: whisper.srt not available at coding time; speech coded from burned-in captions (hook complete at 4 fps, later 1 fps, so some words may be missed). Caption wording in the first 5 s is read from hook frames only. Stage footage is a lecture clip for 400 business owners per his caption; no audio heard. Speech fields checked against the transcript on 09 Nov 2026 (text-only pass).

topic_detail: Marketing funnel in plain terms using boxing 'jab' as a metaphor, then how he uses Instagram question stickers (a free 'jab') to feed a sales funnel of awareness, interest and purchase.
audience: business owners and aspiring entrepreneurs; marketers
caption_vs_video_note: Caption presents it as secrets and 'a clip from a marketing lecture for 400 business owners'; the video is a stage clip edited with a green-screen boxing ring, stock fight pictures and Instagram story screenshots, so it matches. The cover shows him in a punching pose on a boxing ring background with 'אני מוריד לך'.

opening.first_frame: Faded cross-dissolve of Matan on stage (white shirt, headset mic, black background) over a boxing-photo inset, with the caption 'בעולם האגרוף -'.
opening.s0_1: A boxing photo (McGregor and Mayweather) is inset low in the frame under the caption 'בעולם האגרוף -'; at 0.75 s the caption changes to 'היד שבאמת'.
opening.s1_3: He gestures with fists; captions 'יש לה את הכוח' (1.75 s) and 'זו איזו יד?' (2.25 s) as a question; the inset changes at 2.75 s to a boxer hitting an opponent.
opening.s3_5: Green caption 'האחורית!' (2.75 s), 'כי היא באה / עם כל התנופה / עם כל המומנטום / עם כל הגוף!' while he mimes a punch (4 to 5 s) with the red circle on the picture.
opening.visual_hook: A presenter mimes boxing while boxing photos with a red circle show the punch.
opening.spoken_hook: Spoken from 0 s, matches captions: boxing, 'היד שבאמת יש לה את הכוח, זו איזו יד?' (0 to 2.8 s), answer 'האחורית, כי היא באה עם כל התנופה' (2.8 to 4.8 s); machine transcript, some words garbled
opening.text_hook: בעולם האגרוף - / היד שבאמת / יש לה את הכוח / זו איזו יד?
opening.payoff_promised_at_s: 2.75 (the answer to the boxing question appears at once: the rear hand); the marketing link comes at about 9 s
opening.first_sentence_standalone: yes: a self-contained boxing claim and question, though the marketing topic is not yet known
opening.works_without_sound: yes: captions and the inset pictures carry the meaning

visual.subject_placement: On stage, centred, filmed from the audience; captions at about 55 to 60%; insets at 60 to 80%.
visual.setting: Dark stage with a flip chart in a lecture hall with red seats; green-screen boxing ring (blue canvas, red ring ropes) around the cut-out of Matan; Instagram story screenshots; stock insets.
visual.lighting: Stage spotlight on a black background; ring lights.
visual.color_contrast: White clothes against black; captions white, with green and yellow emphasis and red 'מה זו הקלה הזאת!'.
visual.props_and_gestures: Marker pens, flip chart funnel, punching mimes, pointing; he draws the funnel (green, red, blue) with 'מדרך הכל'.
visual.supporting_footage: Boxing photos (McGregor v Mayweather and another fight) at 0 to 5 s; a Mayweather training clip (5 to 6 s); green-screen boxing ring (7 to 8 s); his own Instagram story screenshots with question stickers (11 to 12 s and 42 to 51 s); a Question Responses screen (33 to 35 s); stock photos for 'גבר לאישה', 'תארים', 'כסף' (55 to 58 s); audience shots.
visual.faces_blurred: no for the audience (identifiable faces at 15 to 19 s and 1:11 to 1:12); usernames in the response screen are blurred
visual.visual_progression: 0 to 5 s stage plus fight inset; 5 to 8 s boxing clip and green-screen ring; 9 to 22 s stage, audience, flip chart; 24 to 41 s stage with sticker overlays and Responses screen; 42 to 51 s his stories with the 'אל תעשו תואר' shirt; 52 to 1:25 funnel on the flip chart with stock insets and further stories.
visual.cover_matches_video: partly: cover is a green-screen ring still of the same presenter with the text 'אני מוריד לך', matching the opening metaphor.
visual.ui_interference: Captions at about 55%, inside the safe area; story screenshots carry their own top bars (username at the top) inside the top 14% zone.

editing.edit_function: Information and stimulation: nearly every phrase gets a matching insert (boxing photos, ring, story screenshot, stock photo), the red circle highlights where to look, and the story clips prove that 'question stickers' are his method.
pacing_changes: t=0 to 12s: cuts every 0.5 to 2 s
t=42 to 51s: shots of about 1 to 2 s of his own stories
t=52 to 1:25: flip chart explanation with fewer cuts and stock inserts every 1 s at 55 to 58 s
editing.ending: Last seconds: Matan on stage next to the flip chart funnel, caption 'אנשים שתמיד נטשו לכם פה / הם יתעניינו בזה / ככה זה עובד!' (about 1:21 to 1:25).
editing.rewatch_reasons: Interpretation: dense visuals and a compact funnel diagram may be replayed to follow; no loop.

sound.delivery: Machine transcript shows continuous speech from 0 s with short breaks (about 15 to 16.4 s he asks the room 'מי פה עושה שאלות-תשובות?' and a reaction follows); transcript garbled in places (e.g. 'עיגרוף', 'ג'ב'); transcript ends near 85 s.
sound.sfx: inferred: whoosh-style transitions at the blur cuts (about 0 s, 1:11, 1:13)
sound.sync: Captions follow his speech in 1 to 3 words per second; emphasis words in green or red land on the same beats as his gestures; story screenshots are cut in on the phrase naming them.

text.colour_coding: White default; green for answers or key words ('האחורית!', 'כדי שתגנבו את זה!', 'מקצועית', 'שאלות תשובות', 'להיות מעורבים'); yellow for quoted questions ('מה ההבדל בין עוסק פטור?'); red for outrage ('מה זו הקלה הזאת!') and 'נטשו לכם פה'; '(X2)' and '(X6)' in green for repeat counts.
text.placement: Centre of frame at about 55%, one or two lines.
text.style: Bold sans-serif Hebrew with black outline, 1 to 3 words per beat, no background box.
text.density_and_read_time: 1 to 4 words per caption, changing every 0.5 to 1 s; easy to read but fast.
text.language: Direct, colloquial, mixed English loanwords ('Jab'); humour: 'אתם ערוץ טלוויזיה!'. He quotes viewers ('מתן, איך זה קשור?'). Taglines: 'חכם בטירוף' appears in comments.
text.caption_structure: Long: three lines with emoji, a first line saying he is 'revealing his secrets', a learn-apply-build-money arrow list, a line saying it is from a marketing lecture to 400 business owners, and a P.S. 'הטיפ בסרטון עובד בנזונה!'. Contains slang word 'כוסאומו'; no hashtags, no explicit CTA.
text.rtl_notes: Hebrew RTL correct; English 'Jab' in quotes in the line 'זה בעצם "Jab"'; '(X2)' tags are left to right inside the Hebrew line.

story.setup: Boxing analogy: the strong hand is the rear hand, but the weak 'jab' sets up the punch.
story.stakes: How to get attention and leads on social media.
story.progression: Jab equals small free actions: giving away value through Instagram question stickers; the funnel on the flip chart (awareness, interest, desire, money); a viewer question about the Illuminati as an example; why a funnel works.
story.payoff: A 'question sticker' method: people ask, he answers, and the funnel builds.
story.resolution: Summary: people who left you earlier will become interested; 'ככה זה עובד!'
friction_points: t=5 to 20s: the link from boxing to marketing arrives about 9 s; the first jab explanation uses many fast inserts
t=33 to 35s: static Responses screen with overlapping words
t=45 to 51s: several different stories of him in a row (interpretation: little new information)

explicit_prompts.wording: none (no explicit ask; story stickers appear on screen as the topic)

engagement.comment_notes: Sample of 45 comments, not representative. Most are short praise or emojis ('גאון שיווק', 'חכם בטירוף', 'זה פשוט משפך מדויק'). One asks what to do without enough followers; one notes he learned from Gary V; one mentions 'לימדת את זה במועדון!'.

conversion.offer: none explicit; caption implies learning to build a brand and make money
conversion.benefit: A tip that 'works' ('הטיפ בסרטון עובד בנזונה!').
conversion.proof: His own stories, a stage audience of 400 business owners per the caption.
conversion.cta_fits_content: partly: the content advises question-sticker funnels but the Reel itself asks for nothing

pair_match.notes: n/a (top Reel, no pair in dossier)

rights_and_privacy: Third-party boxing photos and a Mayweather training clip, plus stock photos (including a paparazzi-style celebrity photo at 55 s) are used; identifiable audience members at the event; others' Instagram question texts shown with usernames blurred.
why_it_may_work: Interpretation: a concrete analogy (the boxing rear hand) with an instant answer in the first 3 s, dense visual proof and a clear funnel diagram make an abstract marketing concept easy to follow; 9.5 likes per 1K views and nearly all comments are praise.
why_it_may_underperform: Interpretation: no CTA; heavy use of third-party images and many fast cuts (72) can be tiring.

standout_moments.what: Immediate answer 'האחורית!' to the opening question, a tiny payoff inside 3 s
Story screenshot with a question sticker introduces the 'jab' idea
Red circle around the first funnel level on the flip chart
